newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lafarge rises on results, forecast.
newsitem.headline: Lafarge rises on results, forecast.

text.p: Shares in building materials group Lafarge were up more than two percent in a falling stockmarket on Wednesday after the company reported better than expected operating results and forecast higher profits in 1997.
The share was 2.31 percent higher at 376 francs, while the Paris stockmarket's CAC index was 0.5 percent lower at 1110 GMT.

Lafarge's shares had fallen 3.13 percent on Tuesday ahead of the results, issued early on Wednesday. Although Lafarge's net attributable profit fell to 1.85 billion francs last year from 2.35 billion in 1995, the 3.2 percent rise in operating profit was better than anticipated, brokers said.
The group also forecast a "significant" improvement in 1997 results, underpinned by an anticipated rise of more than 10 percent in sales.
Given the share's weak performance recently, "it's a good share to play on the economic recovery in Europe," a portfolio manager said.
